name: Train an NPC to fight! [1V1 UPDATE]
desc:
ZOMBIE UPDATE - INFECTION IS LIVE

TRAIN AN NPC TO FIGHT
You don't pull the trigger - you upgrade the BRAIN. Spend cash on 14 intelligence stats and watch a clueless rookie become a genius that loots guns, takes the high ground and snipes.

FOUR WORLDS
THE GRID - free-for-all
THE OFFICE - team deathmatch
SANCTUM - capture the flag
THE OUTBREAK - outlive the zombie horde, or join it

16 CLASSES, each with a passive and a Q ability
19 WEAPONS - Pistol > Sniper > Flamethrower > MINIGUN
1v1 DUELS - draw your class, climb the ranks
CASH from kills, idle and offline
REBIRTH for permanent multipliers plus free Cores
Or take control of your fighter yourself

How smart can YOUR NPC get?

scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local BuyIncome = ReplicatedStorage.AIArena.Remotes.BuyIncome
local BuyUpgrade = ReplicatedStorage.AIArena.Remotes.BuyUpgrade
local Rebirth = ReplicatedStorage.AIArena.Remotes.Rebirth

while true do
    BuyIncome:FireServer("PassiveRate")
    BuyIncome:FireServer("KillCash")
    BuyIncome:FireServer("Multiplier")
    BuyIncome:FireServer("Offline")

    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Aim")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Targeting")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Footwork")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Cover")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Positioning")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Survival")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Scavenge")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Reaction")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("FOV")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Vision")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Hearing")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Memory")
    BuyUpgrade:FireServer("Discipline")
    Rebirth:FireServer()

    task.wait(10)
end
